name: Jinzhen Wang
university: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
bio: I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science at UNC Charlotte, where I lead the High-Performance Data Intensive (HPDi) Lab. My research focuses on high-performance computing and scientific data management, with an emphasis on data reduction, compression, and parallel and distributed systems.

I received my Ph.D. from the New Jersey Institute of Technology, advised by Qing Liu, and my bachelor's degree from Shandong University. I was a research intern at Los Alamos National Laboratory from 2022 to 2023. I am also affiliated with the High Performance Computing and Systems Lab at UNC Charlotte.
